data.gender_notes: Pradyot is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit word 'Prabha', meaning lustre or brilliance. The name Pradyot carries the meaning “Lustrous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pradyot usually hope their child will grow to embody lustrous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Pradyot belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lustrous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pradyot total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Pradyot Kishore Deb Barman, a king of the princely state of Tripura in eastern India during the late 18th and early 19th centuries, is known for his military conquests and establishment of a strong centralized administration.
